import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_11/test_0.csv"
]

# Initialize an empty DataFrame to accumulate results
accumulated_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=['sex', 'births'])

# Process each source file
for file_path in source_files:
    # Load source data
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    # Select relevant columns and aggregate births by sex
    grouped = df.groupby('sex', as_index=False)['births'].sum()
    
    # Append to accumulated DataFrame
    accumulated_df = pd.concat([accumulated_df, grouped], ignore_index=True)

# After processing all sources, aggregate again to combine duplicates across sources
final_df = accumulated_df.groupby('sex', as_index=False)['births'].sum()

# Ensure correct data types
final_df['sex'] = final_df['sex'].astype(str)
final_df['births'] = final_df['births'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
final_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_11/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
